## Definition

An LLM compiles immutable raw sources into a persistent wiki that it owns and
maintains; humans curate sources and ask questions
[Karpathy 2026](/wiki/paper/karpathy-2026-llm-wiki.md).

## Scaling

Flat index files degrade beyond a few hundred pages, and one team reported 38%
near-duplicate pages after parallel ingest
[denser 2026](/wiki/source/src-20261029-denser-llm-wiki-survey.md).

> **Status: Disputed**
> Karpathy puts the limit at about 100 sources
> [Karpathy 2026](/wiki/paper/karpathy-2026-llm-wiki.md); the survey says a few
> hundred pages [denser 2026](/wiki/source/src-20261029-denser-llm-wiki-survey.md).
